evals.prompt: Create three generated UI mockup directions for a research dashboard, then build the selected one as HTML/CSS.
evals.expected_output: Creates a design planning folder with meta, content, design brief, v1 manifest.yml, three separate model-ready option prompts, three separate image-generation runs, three separate bitmap images, and uses the selected image as the implementation reference.

evals.prompt: Here is a screenshot and a colour palette. Make a cleaner version, then revise the second image to be denser and less marketing-like.
evals.expected_output: Records screenshot and palette inputs, creates v1 suggestions as separate bitmap images from separate runs, preserves v1, creates v2 with manifest.yml, prompt-v2-option-01.txt, notes, and saves the new image separately.

evals.prompt: Make me a local page where I can compare all the generated design versions side by side.
evals.expected_output: Creates or updates a static review.html that displays images from version folders with version names, filenames, and notes.

evals.prompt: Generate three visual design options for this app screen.
evals.expected_output: Uses the image-generation path only, refuses to substitute SVG or hand-written code, and creates three independent image files from three separate runs rather than one combined image.
